patches.why: Build with relative asset URLs so the app works under /apps/contacts/ (the other Everything apps do the same upstream).

patches.old:
<!-- Performance -->
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://js.puter.com" crossorigin />
    <link rel="dns-prefetch" href="https://js.puter.com" />
patches.why: Remove the preconnect and dns-prefetch to the hosted Puter SDK origin; the build refuses any reference to it and nothing is fetched from Puter.
Remove the canonical link to contacts.puter.com; this copy is not that site.

patches.old:
<!-- Privacy-friendly analytics by Plausible -->
    <script async src="https://plausible.io/js/pa-P2qYwxML7xcGJkqsScQMv.js"></script>
    <script>
      window.plausible =
        window.plausible ||
        function () {
          (plausible.q = plausible.q || []).push(arguments);
        };
      plausible.init =
        plausible.init ||
        function (i) {
          plausible.o = i || {};
        };
      plausible.init();
    </script>
patches.why: Remove the Plausible analytics script and its stub: no third-party tracking, and the CSP would refuse the script anyway. track() is already a no-op without it.
Hide the Smart add button: it needs Puter AI, which the bridge does not provide (ADR-057), so it could only report an error.
The top-bar logo used an absolute URL that would leave the app's path.
Defence in depth: the one place the app called Puter AI now refuses without any SDK call.

patches.old:
if (!window.puter || !window.puter.ai || typeof window.puter.ai.chat !== 'function') {
      errorEl.textContent = 'AI is unavailable right now.'
patches.new:
if (true) {
      errorEl.textContent = 'AI is not available on Homestead. Nothing you paste is sent anywhere.'
patches.why: If Smart add is ever reached it says so plainly and sends nothing.
Remove the Puter AI call from the built app.
The bridge's user name is an opaque sign-in subject; do not show it in the account menu as a handle.
Register Homestead's service worker relative to the app's path, also in the app environment the bridge reports (offline page only).
Manifest URLs relative to the app's path.
Icon URLs relative to the app's path.

patches.why: Remove store screenshots (absolute URLs, install-dialog decoration only).
Remove the wrapper that forced no-store on Puter API calls (it also names the hosted SDK origin, which the build refuses); the shim already sends every bridge request with no-store.
The image build does not run the upstream tests: they assert the unpatched Smart add and are run against the pristine tree instead (see the slice document).
